observations.content: Assistant tested GLM web_search through their zaicp gateway via curl chat/completions with tools:[{type:web_search}]; asking who won most recent FIFA World Cup returned correct Argentina 2022 answer with no tool_calls and no search_result field, but assistant judged this an invalid test since 2022 WC is in training data.
Assistant refined test using fresh-info question (latest getpaseo/paseo release, known correct answer v0.7.0-beta.2) that can only be known via live search.
GLM search fresh-info test returned empty content; second run showed finish_reason:length with 297 of 300 tokens spent on reasoning_content (glm-5.3-flash burns budget thinking).

GLM search test with max_tokens 1500: finish_reason stop, model answered 'I can't check GitHub in real time' — definitive proof the zaicp gateway does NOT pass tools through to a search-capable backend; websearch via current gateway is NOT usable for GLM.
MiniMax web_search exists only on Anthropic endpoint (type web_search_20250305) and is bugged by M3 bug #23, so double-blocked; pi-web-access (exa+jina) remains the search layer.

Completed 3 config edits: ask_question wait default changed 90 to 300 (max) in subagent-types index.ts (52 tests passed, live synced); removed floating npm:pi-mcp-adapter from ~/.pi/agent/settings.json keeping pinned @2.11.0 (packages went from 3 to 2); set observational-memory compactAtContextTokens to 250000 in .pi/settings.json.

Read status.ts lines 27-41: om status report generator shows lines for observers in flight, active observations, next observer (sinceObservation / chunkTokens), pool tokens vs poolTargetTokens/consolidateAtPoolTokens, consolidator idle/running, last compaction wait, topic files, journey, context, session cost, last error, and renderTimeline.
OM timeline: observer started (~10,716 tok); observer +36 (~10,716 tok) $0.2581 (41 runs); consolidator promoted 94 obs $0.4692 (42 runs).

Assistant gave 7-item config review: observer fail auto-regen (coverage-based, failed chunk stays uncovered until next trigger); consolidator fail keeps obs in pool and retries; compactAt 250k applied with other knobs independent axes (~1.6x raw between compactions ~60% more observer runs); worker file already glm-5.3 high (correcting own earlier wrong table); makers at max recommended keep; ask_question now 300s; packages duplicate explained.

User asserted the search angle was wrong: providers (GLM/MiniMax) offer a tool, probably an MCP, for their subscription users specifically, not on the LLM API; asked why assistant didn't use a subagent to research this.
User asked for a real advisory on OM parameters — how adjusting each affects operations (cost/quality/latency/risk) — saying just changing to 250k has no meaning.
User asked assistant to explain in more depth why the old OM report is ineffective and what each of the 5 proposed improvements accomplishes.

Assistant acknowledged both points (should have used subagent for provider search; parameter advice must analyze impact not just change numbers) and spawned researcher subagent 'provider-search-research' (id 1a574492-dedc-4700-bf4a-2cefd22bce11) to research MiniMax Token Plan MCP and Z.ai Coding Plan MCP web-search capability and CLIProxyAPI MCP proxying.
